# A RANGE is a STRUCT in DuckDB, which functions that serialize or inspect values would see, so
# those functions are unsupported for RANGE until they are implemented.

SELECT CAST(r AS JSON) FROM UNNEST([RANGE<DATE> '[2020-01-01, UNBOUNDED)']) AS r
=> error contains: The emulator does not support CAST from RANGE<DATE> to JSON

SELECT APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(r) FROM UNNEST([RANGE(DATE '2020-01-01', NULL)]) r
=> error contains: The emulator does not support aggregate or analytic function APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT with RANGE
